Sometime back I had come across a story about how Xerox had sued some other business on the use of the word xerox. The story goes that Xerox succeeded in getting an urgent injunction and the court order apparently read:- Parties can act on the  xerox copy of the order.
SO I thought let me try and verify if there is such an incident. From there mind went to Google, Vaseline. And the curiosity as to what such a scenario is called. My memory trick was to remember is as synagogue with a D  in middle instead of G for the pronunciation.
Thanks for coming to my TedTalk
Pardon my spelling, fastest fingers first became fattest fingers first 🫠
I had heard or read of the term 'Google Effect' but didn't recall what it was. Looked up what it meant. This is what it feels like when irony slaps you across the face.
This honestly prompted me to ask one more, though I had said the last one was my last one lol
I looked it up as well
Tell me that popped up in your mind when you looked up Google Effect. ‎<This message was edited>
